label: Applying with an IB Diploma through optagelse.dk

rounds.label: The only round for applicants with an international qualification
rounds.note: There is no later round for IB holders. The 5 July deadline that Danish-qualified applicants use does not apply to you.

milestones.label: Optagelse.dk opens for the 2027 intake
milestones.note: The portal typically opens in early February. Confirm the exact date when the Agency publishes it.

milestones.label: Have your IB coordinator register you for IB results
milestones.note: Not an official deadline, but results must be authorised to travel before the documentation deadline. Get a receipt. Institution codes: Copenhagen 002600, Aarhus 000150, Aalborg 000148, Southern Denmark 000157.

milestones.label: Applications close
milestones.note: Twelve noon, not midnight. Applies to every applicant with an international or IB qualification, whether the diploma was earned in Denmark or abroad, and whether you are aiming at quota 1 or quota 2.

milestones.label: Sign the application (signature page if you have no MitID)
milestones.note: With MitID you sign inside optagelse.dk. Without MitID, print the signature page, sign it by hand and email or post it to every institution you apply to. Never uploaded. The application is not complete without it.

milestones.label: Last day to reorder priorities; documentation at some institutions
milestones.note: Priorities can be reordered until 12:00. Documentation deadlines are set by each institution: Aarhus and Aalborg accept documents until 5 July, Copenhagen wants them with the application on 15 March, and some academies set 1 April. Check each one you list.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: After the Danish documentation deadline, which is why the results service exists.

milestones.label: Offers and quota 1 cut-offs published
milestones.note: Every programme's cut-off average is published the same day. Vacant places appear in the same week.

milestones.label: Accept your place
milestones.note: Set by each institution, a few days after offers. In 2026: Copenhagen 2 August, Southern Denmark 3 August, Aalborg 5 August. Dated here at the earliest known.

submissionItems.label: The application itself, with up to eight ranked programmes
Your most recent IB transcript or predicted grades
IB results service registration
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: IBIS, addressed to the institutions you name
submissionItems.note: Your IB coordinator does this. Up to six institutions.

submissionItems.label: Signature page, where the institution requires one
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: The institution's admissions office, by post or email

submissionItems.label: Documentation for quota 2
submissionItems.note: Employer statements giving responsibilities, dates and weekly hours; transcripts in the original language and in English. If unsure whether something counts, submit it — the admissions office picks what helps you.

submissionItems.label: Passport copy and residence permit, for non-EU applicants

supplementarySteps: Some programmes add an admission test or a motivational essay with its own earlier deadline.
Fee-paying applicants face tighter documentation deadlines that differ by institution — Aarhus has required 15 March, Aalborg 1 May. Check yours early, because it can rule out the whole year.

notes: Dates carrying provisional: true are inherited from the published national pattern, which states day and month but not year. They must be re-verified once the Agency publishes 2027-dated pages.
